sections.text:
brecht composuit et ad nos summa cum benevolentia abhinc paucos dies, interce-
dente Kroll, misit Hephaestionis capita libri III quae cum Florentino codice con-
cordant definire possumus.
sections.en: brecht composed and sent to us with the greatest benevolence a few days ago, with Kroll intervening, the chapters of Hephaestion's book III which we can determine agree with the Florentine codex.

summary.headline: Hephaestion Book III Chapter List
summary.text: Continuation of a folio-by-folio list of Hephaestion’s Book III chapters agreeing with the Florentine codex, covering parents, the lot and death of the mother, the unreared, times of life, dignity, action, children, friends and enemies, slaves, foreign travel, divisions of time, and planetary chronocratories. Cross-references cite Ptolemy, Manetho, and chapter numbers 4–30; a footnote records Brecht’s collation with Kroll’s intervention.
